title: Optimal clique partitions under local perturbations
abstract: A Lean 4 / Mathlib formalization of the main results of the author's preprint "Optimal Clique Partitions under Local Perturbations" (Erdős #81 series, Paper VI). For a graph G on n vertices with a core P of size p = ⌊(n+1)/3⌋, h = Δ(G △ (K_P ∨ I_O)) and u, s, m the numbers of core, crossing and exterior edges: if p ≥ 18h + 1 then cp(G) = cp_{≤4}(G) = s − u − 2m = M(n) + C − A − 2m with M(n) = ⌊n(n+1)/6⌋ (Theorem A), and cp_{≤3}(G) − cp(G) = m (Theorem B); if p ≥ 63h, every assignment of the orders 4 or 5 to the exterior edges is realized by an optimal partition (Theorem C); for p ≥ 16 each assignment has at least p^{⌊p²/64⌋} optimal partitions and 2^m p^{⌊p²/64⌋} ≤ N(G) ≤ (n+1)^{5e(G)} (Theorem E). Also: the formula for other core sizes in an explicit window (Proposition 2.1), the intrinsic maximum over all cores (§8.1), the exact optimum with one exceptional vertex, cp = cp_{≤4} = cp*_= = s − u − 2m + D(a,b), ν₃ = ν₃* = u + min(a,b) and the restriction gap (Theorem D), and the complete-join variant cp(G) = M(n) − 2m (Theorem A.1). Twelve statements in all. The constants 18, 63, 16 and 24 are those of the paper; their optimality is not claimed.
